# Enertor

> Enertor designs and manufactures premium shock-absorbing running insoles (PX1 and UltraSole) backed by clinical research and endorsed by Usain Bolt.

Enertor is a British manufacturer of performance footwear technology specializing in PX1 running and walking insoles with 89% shock absorption capability. The company combines scientific research from the University of Melbourne with practical coaching and injury prevention expertise.

## Key Topics

- PX1 Running Insoles
- UltraSole Recovery Technology
- Shock Absorption
- Injury Prevention
- Plantar Fasciitis Relief
- Medial Tibial Stress Syndrome
- Athletic Performance
- Orthotic Footwear
- Impact Reduction
- Walking Insoles
- Sports Performance

- Recovery Slides

- British Manufacturing
